author: musho7-dev
subject: Make every map harder: jump ramps, steeper late hills, fuel pressure
body:
Measured with a new "smart" self-test driver that drives like a decent
player (keeps the car level in the air, eases off on wheelies relative
to the slope). Before: a skilled run with a maxed Buggy on Dust Mesa
was still going at 1,763 m.

- Jump ramps from ~100 m, every 110 m, ending in a short cliff; they
  grow from 3.5 m to 9 m high, so air control decides the landing
- Hills grow faster after 150 m and keep growing to 2.4x
- Fuel burns faster with distance (+33% at 1 km); cans spaced
  210 m + 30 m per can

After: careless driving crashes on a ramp (~240 m); skilled runs end
around 500 m with no upgrades and 500-900 m with maxed cars, mostly
out of fuel, so tank upgrades, fuel cans and fuel delivery matter.
